notes.title: Sentry City Price drop!
notes.notes: Sentry City's price has dropped to just $4.99. Now's a great time to take advantage of this price drop! Thanks for playing Sentry City.

notes.title: Patch notes
notes.notes:
Over the past month or so I rolled out a couple patches that fixed a few things:

*made a text pop-up appear on first level to ensure that players know they can go through one-way platforms 

*fixed minor bugs with enemies throughout different levels

*made options for sound levels and default values buttons in main menu
